title: Cancer-Predisposition-Syndrome Registry 01
summary: Cancer predisposition syndromes (CPS) are genetic conditions associated with an increased cancer risk. Approximatly 10% of all children and adolescents with cancer have an underlying CPS. We are a team of scientists and pediatric oncologists and it is our aim to advance CPS research in order to improve surveillance strategies and therapeutic options for patients with CPS.
conditions: Li-Fraumeni syndrome, familial occurance of cancer, cancer predisposition syndromes

interventions.name:
Natural History Study.
Data and biospecimen of patients with cancer predisposition syndromes are collected once a year.
- Evaluation of the feasibility and benefit of cancer surveillance programs
- Development of a radiological image database for CPS
- Establishment of a CPS mutation database
-

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Proven cancer predisposition syndrome, high-level suspicion of a cancer predisposition syndrome
Exclusion criteria:
none
